description.en: A national financial-inclusion programme through which an unbanked person can open a basic savings bank deposit account at a bank branch or Bank Mitra outlet.

benefit_summary.en: The account has no minimum-balance requirement, earns deposit interest, provides a RuPay debit card, can receive direct benefit transfers, and may provide accident cover and an overdraft up to Rs 10,000 subject to the current scheme conditions.

eligibility_summary.en: It is intended for an unbanked person who does not already have another bank account. The bank applies current KYC and account-opening rules.

name.en: Aadhaar or another officially valid KYC document

notes.en: The official page lists alternatives and simplified rules when Aadhaar is unavailable; confirm the bank's current KYC requirement.

instruction.en: Visit a bank branch or authorised Bank Mitra outlet.
Ask to open a PMJDY basic savings bank deposit account and complete KYC.
Ask the bank to explain RuPay-card activation, insurance conditions, direct-benefit transfer linkage, and overdraft eligibility.
